historical.participial_analysis: Merrill uses cotschimé-ameke as the explicit verbal example of -ameke as adjectivizer/nominalizer [participial].
historical.internal_morphology_of_ameke: Merrill independently analyzes historical participial -(a)me plus optional reduplicative -kV/-ke in relevant suffix chains.

modern_src02.participle_status: source-note-attested, not independent headword in current SRC-02

modern_choguita_caballero_2022.translation: I really wanted to go along sleeping
modern_choguita_caballero_2022.significance: The modern Choguita grammar explicitly treats kotʃi as the verbal root to which productive suffixes attach; modern roothood therefore does not depend on stripping material from SRC-02 Cochí.
modern_choguita_caballero_2022.negative_result: No audited modern -mê suffix provides a source-grounded explanation of historical cotschimé simply by formal resemblance.

independent_uto_aztecan_support.source: Hill 2020, Wick Miller's Uto-Aztecan Cognate Sets
independent_uto_aztecan_support.status: comparative support; Hill notes that some sets remain provisional

evidential_architecture.family_core_form_semantics: strongly supported: historical Merrill koči- / modern Caballero kotʃi / SRC-02 Cochí / Hill Rarámuri kotᶴi, all in the sleep domain
evidential_architecture.participial_function: double source-explicit: historical cotschimé-ameke and modern SRC-02 Cochí -> pp. cochíami
evidential_architecture.historical_ame_internal_structure: supported by Merrill: participial -(a)me with optional -kV/-ke in relevant chains

open_problem.label: historical cotschimé -mé problem
open_problem.question: Why does Steffel's historical verb occur as kočimé while independently documented modern varieties analyze/use a koči/kotʃi root?
ruled_out_shortcuts: Do not simply delete -mé from the historical lemma.
Do not identify historical -mé with modern motion-imperative or irrealis -mê by homophony.
Do not convert Merrill's family heading COTSCHI- into a morpheme segmentation of cotschimé unless supported by explicit analysis.
